errors.evidence: The description states that the unit for the y-axis is percentage, but no unit is specified on the y-axis in the figure.

The description reports the value for the light gray bar in experiment 4 as approximately 70.8. However, the bar is visually one of the lowest in its series, at a similar height to the bar in experiment 2 (around 70.3-70.5), and clearly lower than the bars in experiments 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 10. A value of 70.8 is incorrectly high.
